headline: Vaswani Industries releases AGM voting outcomes
hook: AGM voting results submitted to exchanges
summary: Vaswani Industries Limited has submitted the official voting results from its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026. Routine shareholder approvals and resolutions were processed at the meeting. Shareholders and compliance trackers can review the finalized voting tallies on the exchange portals. This is a routine corporate filing with no direct impact on retail stock valuations.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no immediate financial impact for retail holders.

headline: Vaswani Industries submits AGM scrutinizer report to the exchange
summary: Vaswani Industries Limited has submitted the official scrutinizer's report from its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026, to the stock exchange. This is a routine compliance filing confirming the voting results and proceedings of the meeting. For an Indian retail investor, this procedural update holds minimal immediate financial impact.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no immediate impact on share price.
